messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate on /v1/embeddings (eu-prod). Incident INC-2026-2145. 5xx spike + p95 tail up. Details: https://alerts.redwood.internal/INC-2026-2145
Alex: I'm primary for EU today — taking lead. Spike started ~2145678800 UTC. 5xx ~12% above baseline, p95 from 1.8s -> 3.4s. First hypothesis: KV cache pressure / eviction storm.
Sam: I'm secondary, standing by. Do we need customer comms yet?
oncall-bot: Paging routed to Alex, Sam. Escalation timeline: primary 5m -> secondary.
Alex: Quick mitigation plan: 1) reduce embeddings batch_size on route, 2) drain older nodes, 3) enable verbose kv-cache logging. Commands I'm running now:
`````kubectl scale deployment embeddings-eu --replicas=3
curl -XPOST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/ops/config -d '{"route":"embeddings","batch_size":4}'
```
Maya: Can I pick up the next handoff at 2145682000? I'll be ready to take primary. Please leave a short handover note.
Li: There's an embeddings KV cache runbook section: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-kv-cache — see steps 4.2 (toggle prefix caching, check TTLs, analyze eviction rate).
Priya: Support: AcmeAnalytics reported 503s (SUP-8192). They saw errors ~21:45-21:55 UTC. Support created an initial responder note and pinged account team.
Alex: Filed engineering ticket RGW-3421 to capture debugging, timeline, and postmortem work. Assigned to eng-runtime. https://jira.redwood.com/browse/RGW-3421
Sam: Added runbook link to RGW-3421, created a calendar invite "INC-2026 retro" Mon 09:00 PST. Invitees: eng-runtime, eng-infra, support, devex.
Sam: Also opened an infra tweak PR to lower default embeddings batch size as a short-term safety: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1287
Alex: Current metrics before handoff: 5xx down to ~3%, p95 ~1.2s, autoscaler paused, nodepool eu-gpu-5 at stable. Handoff in 5m. Logs collected to s3: s3://redwood-ops/INC-2026/collection.tar.gz
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary -> Maya at 2145679300. Next automated check at 2145679900.
Maya: Taking over as primary. Thanks Alex. I'll keep autoscaler paused for 30m, monitor KV eviction metrics, and coordinate with eng-runtime for deep dive. Ping me for any escalations.
Li: I'll grep for kv-cache evictions and upload output to RGW-3421 (will post link when done).
Priya: Support updated AcmeAnalytics with ETA and promised a 30m follow-up message.
Sam: Post-handoff action items tracked in RGW-3421: [1] Postmortem draft; [2] Observability improvements for KV cache eviction metrics; [3] Auto-fallback to safer batch-size when error-rate spikes; [4] Stress test and capacity validation for eu-gpu-5 pool.
Alex: Timeline note uploaded to RGW-3421 and S3. I left a short writeup in the ticket summarizing steps taken.
Maya: I'll monitor for 30m and escalate if any regression. I'll close this thread when incident is stable and tickets/retros are linked.
oncall-bot: INC-2026 state -> MONITORING. No active pages in last 5m.
Alex: Closing my watch. Good handoff, team. We'll follow up in RGW-3421 and during the retro. :+1:
